_readme: Maps legacy letter-prefixed cost codes onto the numeric cost-code system. Edit 'to' values and re-run reconcile.py; nothing else needs to change. confidence: high = corroborated by a shared bill/check number or an exact name match; medium = category-level match, no document evidence; review = MUST be confirmed by a human before the reallocation is trusted.
